q1_issues.issue: (Theme sk_cancel_1 sk_flight_1) should be Patient: the instruction set names this exact case, an object that is itself a scheduled occurrence (a flight) with a verb that changes whether or when it happens (cancel, postpone, reschedule) is altered, so it takes Patient.

notes: The rest matches the instruction set's own worked examples: a singular collective "an airline" gets a plain event with the group as role-filler and no distribution rule, and evening_flight fuses with the head genus (Inheritance evening_flight flight) emitted and the noun modifier withheld, exactly as night_shift is specified. Bare simple present correctly gets no status atom.
